# The Vindicators

> Band di rock'n'roll e garage di Bassano del Grappa (Italia), nata nel 1986. Tre dischi (That's All Rock 1987, Roots Revolution 1989, Greatest Hits 2012) e 102 concerti tra il 1986 e il 1992; oggi di nuovo dal vivo. / Rock'n'roll and garage band from Bassano del Grappa, Italy, formed in 1986. Three records and 102 shows between 1986 and 1992; playing live again.

Next date / Prossima data: 31 October 2026, Capitol, Pordenone (opening for The Fleshtones).

## Key facts / Fatti principali
- Formed in 1986 in Bassano del Grappa, Italy, right after the Frigidaire Tango split; named as a tribute to The Fleshtones. / Nati nel 1986 a Bassano del Grappa, dopo lo scioglimento dei Frigidaire Tango; il nome omaggia i Fleshtones.
- Records / Dischi: That's All Rock (1987, 12 tracks, recorded at Art Music Studio, Bassano), Roots Revolution (1989, 12 tracks, Casal Gajardo Records), Greatest Hits (2012, double CD, Go Down Records).
- Line-up / Formazione: Charli Out Cazale (vocals), Stewie DC (guitar), Paul Milanì (sax); Fernando Viktor (bass) and Mark Charles (drums) from 1989.
- 102 shows between 1986 and 1992; split in 1992; back with Greatest Hits in 2012.
- Full tracklists and audio listening: https://thevindicators.it/records (IT) · https://thevindicators.it/en/records (EN).
- FAQ: https://thevindicators.it/story · https://thevindicators.it/en/story
